use_case: Ambient clinical documentation (AI scribe) drafting visit notes from recorded patient conversations
vendor_or_model: AI scribe vendor (generative speech-to-text and language model)
data_categories: Visit audio; transcripts; draft clinical notes (ePHI)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (documentation); escalates to Health care if diagnosis or order suggestions are enabled
human_in_the_loop: Provider reviews edits and signs every note before it enters the record
applicable_laws: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (BAA required); Fla. Stat. 934.03 all-party recording consent; 45 CFR 92.210 if clinical suggestion features are enabled; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Pilot (3 providers); new enrollments paused until BAA executed

use_case: EHR rule-based clinical decision support alerts (preventive screening and drug interaction reminders)
human_in_the_loop: Providers accept or dismiss each alert
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (non-automated and automated tools that support clinical decision-making are in scope); inputs include age and sex

use_case: General-purpose generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft letters
applicable_laws: HIPAA (no BAA = impermissible disclosure if PHI entered)
status: Prohibited for PHI (POL-05 4.8); approved enterprise tool under evaluation
